title: Rabdosichuanin C inhibits productions of pro-inflammatory mediators regulated by NF-kappaB signaling in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 cells.
authors: Lingxia, Zhang; Hong, Wu; Man, Gong; Xinzhou, Wang; Lili, Wang; Zhimin, Wang; Liping, Dai; Erping, Xu
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和药效团模拟筛选天然化合物RC抑制IκB/NF-κB通路，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但核心是炎症信号通路而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Chronic pharyngitis (CP) is an inflammatory disease of the pharyngeal mucosa and its lymphatic tissues that is difficult to treat clinically. However, research on the exact therapeutic agents and molecular mechanisms of CP is still unclear. In this study, we investigated Rabdosichuanin C (RC) to attenuate lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced inflammatory damage in RAW264.7 cells by a combination of targeted virtual screening and in vitro activity assay and further clarified its molecular mechanism of action centering on the IkappaB/nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) pathway. Molecular docking and pharmacophore simulation methods were used to screen compounds with IkappaB inhibitory effects. Expression of genes and proteins related to the IkappaB/NF-kappaB signaling pathway by RC in LPS-induced inflammatory injury model of RAW264.7 cells was detected by PCR, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, and Western blot. The docking of RC with IkappaB protein showed good binding energy, and pharmacophore simulations further confirmed the active effect of RC in inhibiting IkappaB protein. RC intervention in LPS-induced RAW264.7 cells significantly reduced the expression levels of inflammatory factors tumor necrosis factor-alpha, interleukins-6, iNOS, and CD-86 at the messenger RNA and protein levels, downregulated IkappaB, p65 protein phosphorylation levels, and significantly inhibited IkappaB/NF-kappaB signaling pathway activation. Virtual screening provided us with an effective method to rapidly identify compounds RC that target inhibit the action of IkappaB, and the activity results showed that RC inhibits NF-kappaB signaling pathway activation. It is suggested that RC may play a role in the treatment of CP by inhibiting the IkappaB/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 慢性咽炎（CP）是咽部黏膜及其淋巴组织的一种炎症性疾病，临床上难以治疗。然而，关于CP的确切治疗药物及其分子机制的研究仍不明确。在本研究中，我们通过靶向虚拟筛选与体外活性测定相结合的方法，探讨了Rabdosichuanin C（RC）对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的RAW264.7细胞炎症损伤的缓解作用，并进一步阐明了其以IkappaB/核因子kappa B（NF-kappaB）通路为核心的分子作用机制。采用分子对接和药效团模拟方法筛选具有IkappaB抑制作用的化合物。通过PCR、酶联免疫吸附测定和Western blot检测RC在LPS诱导的RAW264.7细胞炎症损伤模型中对IkappaB/NF-kappaB信号通路相关基因和蛋白表达的影响。RC与IkappaB蛋白的对接显示出良好的结合能，药效团模拟进一步证实了RC抑制IkappaB蛋白的活性作用。RC干预LPS诱导的RAW264.7细胞显著降低了炎症因子肿瘤坏死因子-α、白细胞介素-6、iNOS和CD-86在信使RNA和蛋白水平的表达，下调了IkappaB、p65蛋白磷酸化水平，并显著抑制了IkappaB/NF-kappaB信号通路的激活。虚拟筛选为我们提供了一种快速识别靶向抑制IkappaB作用的化合物RC的有效方法，活性结果表明RC抑制了NF-kappaB信号通路的激活。提示RC可能通过抑制IkappaB/NF-kappaB信号通路在CP的治疗中发挥作用。
